understanding 还有 4 个未消化的 unknowns: Blocker 4 resolution architecture: option (a) pre-commit verification — authority POST happens before the local evidence write commits, so authority failure short-circuits with no local write; option (b) compensating rollback — both writes happen, then authority failure triggers a deterministic local rollback before non-zero exit. Both satisfy Blocker 4; PLAN decision picks one.; Submission protocol shape: what exact request / response types must be added to authority-contracts.ts. Source materials = stash@{3}'s authority-contracts.ts (~851 lines, super-set) and authority-client.ts; reading both to extract minimum-viable submission types is part of PLAN before locking decision.json.; Authority server URL / auth config source: env var (KOALA_AUTHORITY_URL?) vs config file vs both with precedence. PLAN must pick.…
